name: Calvin Montague
summary: At Deathknell's gate, Calvin Montague catches newly awakened Forsaken on their way out and tricks passersby into running errands for him.

sections.title: A Grifter by the Gate
sections.body: Calvin Montague waits beyond Deathknell's gates, where the road leads into Tirisfal Glades. He tries to persuade wandering adventurers to carry his letters with false promises. He will neither handle his own correspondence nor pay a fair courier's fee. Other prominent undead named Montague manage banking interests in the Undercity. Calvin follows a less reputable path, relying on petty schemes and deception.

sections.title: A Rogue's Scheme
sections.body: Calvin Montague offers travelers a sealed message to carry for him. Those with sharp wits or underworld training can see through his words. Newly risen undead may still be seeking purpose in Tirisfal's bleak ruins. Calvin's offer shows how scarce trust can be in the service of the Dark Lady.

faq.answer: Calvin Montague is a Forsaken rogue waiting near Deathknell's exit gate in Tirisfal Glades. He tries to cheat newly risen undead into running an unpaid errand for him.

faq.q: What does Calvin want adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Calvin Montague tries to persuade passing travelers to carry a letter under false pretenses. He hopes smooth talk will earn him free courier service.

faq.q: Is Calvin Montague related to the Undercity bankers?
faq.answer: Calvin shares his surname with prominent Undercity bankers Ophelia, Mortimer, William, and Randolph Montague. No family relationship has been confirmed.

faq.q: Where can Calvin Montague be found?
faq.answer: Calvin Montague waits along the road just outside Deathknell's wooden northern gate, where he can intercept adventurers heading into Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: As a Forsaken rogue, you can recognize Calvin Montague's attempt to manipulate the uninitiated as a cheap hustle by a fellow cutpurse.
As one of the newly risen leaving Deathknell, you may learn early that not all of Sylvanas's subjects seek solidarity.
